observed_result.summary: At the M04 claims candidate the tests that read the claim table pass on macOS, Linux and Windows. M04 adds no claim entry (ruling I-28). A WSL Mode B or container binding reads every claim-table field unknown on a host that otherwise qualifies, while a native binding there keeps the entries (wsl_mode_b_binding_reads_every_claim_field_unknown_on_a_qualifying_windows_host, container_binding_reads_every_claim_field_unknown_on_a_qualifying_linux_host), with reasons an M03 reader decodes; on Unix the runtime records each grant's endpoint kind fail closed (claim_endpoint_is_native_only_for_the_runtimes_own_environment), results name it (a15_container_ and wsl_mode_b_binding_result_names_its_endpoint_kind_for_the_claim_table), and a result stored before I-28 is replayed and observed with its claims withheld, the record unchanged (a15_container_replay_of_a_pre_i28_result_withholds_its_claims). The observations: 7 entries apply on macOS 27.2.1 with 10.5p1 and on Linux 6.8.0-147-generic with 9.6p1, 5 on Windows 10.0.26300.9974 with 9.5p2.

limitations: Targeted reruns (ADR-0009 section 2 item 2): nine commands on macOS, seven test binaries on Linux, seven commands on Windows; check.sh ran on macOS at this commit (3476 passed, 0 failed, 199 ignored).

The runtime live tests (the endpoint-kind wiring, the fail-closed classification, the replay and observe regression) are Unix-only; Windows runs the report tests, which judge Windows and Linux host facts on every platform. integration_managed_adapter has two Unix-only tests (52 passed on Windows, 54 on macOS).

No WSL run: a WSL host is `wsl`, which no entry names, and M04's claims update adds no entry; the Mode B and container cases are covered by the report tests and the Unix live tests over the fake bridge and the engine-free container fixture.

Superseded runs at 212f290a are kept in superseded-212f290a: macOS and Linux passed; Windows failed report_for_local_managed_binding_with_empty_claim_table on a CRLF checkout of the golden (fixed at 6a7d91cc: the test matches the golden's text with LF endings). A Linux run at 6a7d91cc (passed, 497 tests) was deleted by an integrator error before it was committed; the Linux row was run again at this commit, so all three rows are at 22365562.

Mode A is native for the claim table (ADR-0010 section 2); its values are judged against the runtime's verified client, which may be a configured [clients].ssh rather than the in-box ssh.exe Mode A runs (M04-CL-R03, a recorded limitation).
Debug test-configured builds: no entry is a custody claim; lock_continuity stays not_verified (follow-up M04-F4 before any such entry).

The Windows logs are redacted: the scratch checkout reads <scratch> and the Windows home <home>. The Windows run's commit is as reported by the orchestrator's agent. Its command lines are those sent to that agent (with --locked); the logs carry the output, not the command lines.
